_about: Where each effect or sprite piece sits in the key art (pipeline/art/references.json element `keyart`, 1672x941): the context pair shows the in-engine capture cut to the piece against this crop, never a whole dark graybox frame against the whole key art (check defect, 13 Nov). rect = [x, y, w, h] in key-art pixels. A piece with no entry is shown against its own first reference image on its own background. Matched by exact element id, else by prefix.
